create_run_manager: create a RunManager instance to manage async runs with thread-based isolation and locking
create_run_record: create a new pending run record with thread_id, assistant_id, and multitask_strategy for async task execution
cancel_run: cancel an in-flight run by run_id, triggering abort event and task cancellation with interrupt or rollback action
check_inflight_runs: check if a thread already has pending or running runs before creating a new one with conflict detection
list_thread_runs: list all runs for a given thread_id ordered newest first with thread-scoped filtering
